blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Parañaque City government has installed metal detectors in public schools across the city. The move is in a bid to enhance student safety amid recent incidents of school shootings and stabbings in various parts of the country. According to the city government in a statement, a total of 16 walk–through metal detectors, also known as full body scanners, have, so far, been installed in different high schools in Parañaque.
